title: Reading Drill — The Workshop Sign-in Sheet
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Workshop Sign-in Sheet
passages.body:
**A** A repair club used an attendance sheet which recorded only names. Its organiser added a place to write what each person had brought, hoping to learn which spare parts were likely to be needed.

**B** The new sheet showed that some problems were seasonal. Loose bicycle fittings were common in spring, while people asked about heaters in autumn. The club ordered only small quantities at first to avoid wasting money.

**C** At the end of the year, an organiser counted how many visitors returned after a repair. She did not treat a return visit as proof of success because some people came back with the same fault.

questions.prompt: Its organiser added a place to write what each person had brought, hoping to learn which ______ were likely to be needed.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.

questions.explanation: The club ordered only small quantities at first to avoid wasting money.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: She did not treat a return visit as proof of success because some people came back with the same fault.

questions.prompt: The project measured how much money every visitor saved.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
